note: Real defects found this session via mechanism-first audit of the live realtime path. Each has a red-first regression test (failure-to-regression).

defects.first_divergence: COMPLETION regex group /כבר\s+(שלחתי|התקשרתי|חייגתי|שלחת)/ included 2nd-person 'שלחת' ('YOU sent'); the monitor exists to catch the ASSISTANT falsely claiming IT (1st person) completed an action.
defects.reproduction: detectForbiddenCompletion('כבר שלחת לו את זה?') returned a violation -> assistant question wrongly triggers 'fabricated_completion' repair.
defects.fix: Removed 2nd-person 'שלחת' from the group and wrapped the group in the 'לא ' negation guard; only 1st-person completions count.
defects.regression_test: src/screens/AbuAI/realtime/truthMonitor.test.ts :: 'forward-Hebrew false positive: a 2nd-person question is NOT a 1st-person completion'

defects.first_divergence: /דיברתי\s+עם/ lacked the 'לא ' negation guard that every other completion verb (שלחתי/התקשרתי/חייגתי/נשלח) carried.
defects.reproduction: detectForbiddenCompletion('לא דיברתי עם מור עדיין') returned a violation -> truthful negation over-blocked.
defects.regression_test: src/screens/AbuAI/realtime/truthMonitor.test.ts :: 'forward-Hebrew false positive: negated "דיברתי עם" is truthful, never flagged'

defects.first_divergence: CAPABILITY_DENIAL matched /לא\s+יכולה\s+ל(ה?תקשר|שלוח|שלח)/ — it covered 'להתקשר' (to call) but NOT 'לחייג' (to dial), a first-class call verb in a product that PREPARES calls.
defects.reproduction: detectUnsupportedDenial('אני לא יכולה לחייג לו', {status:'READY_FOR_HANDOFF'}) returned [] — the model could deny a READY call capability unchecked.
defects.fix: Added 'חייג' to the denial verb set: /לא\s+יכולה\s+ל(ה?תקשר|חייג|שלוח|שלח)/ (mechanism, not phrase). Genuinely-absent capability (NOT_CONFIGURED) stays truthful.
